日文：サキュバスじゃないモン！
英文：I'm not a succubus!
中文：才不是魅魔呢！
1卷
这是专注于“非人类少女”魅力的次世代厂牌“Young Unreal Comics”推出的第二部作品，讲述了一位人类少女在全是“怪物娘”的班级里，那令人心跳加速的校园生活！害羞美丽的少女樱（Sakura）转入了一个全员皆为怪物娘的班级；因对处境感到不安，她谎称自己是魅魔。她与一群个性独特的同学共度校园时光：活力四射的哈耳皮埃（鸟身女妖）、言辞辛辣的拉米亚（蛇女）、目光灼灼注视着她的独眼少女，以及对“魅魔”心存戒备的认真半人马……书中充满了略带色气、跨越种族的少女间亲密互动！
■漫画内容
第1话：樱花纷飞的开学日
第2话：翱翔天际！
第3话：微烧与独眼少女
第4话：雨天与拉米亚
特别篇：明天就是大日子（全新内容）

The second release from "Young Unreal Comics"—a new-generation label dedicated to the allure of non-human girls—features the heart-pounding school life of the only human girl in a class full of monster girls! Sakura, a shy and beautiful girl, enrolls in a class populated entirely by monster girls; anxious about her situation, she lies and claims to be a succubus. She spends her days alongside a unique cast of classmates: an energetic harpy, a sarcastic lamia, a one-eyed girl who gazes at Sakura with intense interest, and an earnest centaur wary of the succubus... Packed with plenty of slightly risqué, interspecies girl-on-girl bonding!
■COMICS
Chapter 1: First Day of School Amidst Falling Cherry Blossoms
Chapter 2: Together in the Sky!
Chapter 3: A Slight Fever and the One-Eyed Girl
Chapter 4: Rain, Then a Lamia
Special Chapter: Tomorrow's the Big Day (All-New Content)
n: [Manga] I'm not a succubus! 才不是魅魔呢！1卷[English]
